Department: Career Development Centre (CDC)

28717.description:
Lecturer/Senior Lecturer


School of Business & Management (SoBM) - Port Moresby, NCD




 












Position Title: Lecturer/Senior Lecturer
Department: School of Business & Management (SoBM)
Location: IBSUniversity, 11 Mile Campus 
Reports To: Head - School of Business & Management 


Employment Type: Full-Time




ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT:


The Institute of Business Studies (IBS), from its’ humble beginning in 1987 as an arm of Nades & Associates primarily providing revision classes for the needs of Papua New Guinea. 
Institute of Accountants (now CPA PNG) has evolved into a private University level Institution over the last 38 years. Today we are one of the largest business schools in the country and off degree programmes in the fields of Accounting & Finance, Business & 
Management, Economics & Development Studies and Information Technology. We also continue to provide study pathways for grade 10 & 12 school leavers including industry accreditations for those seasoned professionals who want to get certified in their field. 


 


Our success is the fruits of our dedicated team committed to making a difference in Papua New Guinea, through their efforts to help educate current and futures citizens on Papua New Guinea. 


A CAREER WITH US: 
At IBS we believe that everyone has been gifted with natural talents and learnt skills. Our recruitment process is designed to help candidates understand this and enable us to better match you with a role that you will not only be able to do but enjoy doing. Career progression is also important to us and believes that each employee should be at the driving seat of their career progression - this means your manager will discuss with you where you want to be in the future and be more of a coach for you in terms of giving you feedback on areas you need to work on to be your best and achieve your goals. We also have a lot of staff events that enable us to celebrate as a team and give recognition where it's due.


 


ABOUT THE ROLE 
The Lecturer plays a pivotal role to ensure we have highly engaged and productive students that are enriched through education in unison to prosper in their life goals and achievements. As the gatekeeper of our student’s success, you will promote student management best practices that can be easily digested and embraced across the organization. 


The Lecturer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining a modern Academic function that is digital on the inside—harnessing digital + cloud technologies to effectively capture and manage all aspects of delivering the best student experience for the Institution. Overseeing and managing the entire lecturing process, you will ensure all 
students are engaged both academically and socially to maintain a healthy balance and effectively utilize our finite academic infrastructure resources. This position incorporates a high degree of unsupervised work; as an outcome focused person, you will display strong conflict resolution skills and enjoy managing your workload and being part of a productive team. 


 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 


 


In a highly student-focused role, the Lecturer should focus on strong collaboration, communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.  It is also essential that you understand Business and Management best practices and local industry trends. Lecturer duties will involve managing and monitoring undergraduate programs. This includes associated 
operational administration, curriculum development, course materials review and quality management and enhancement. Lecturer duties include but are not limited to the following: 


 


Learning & Teaching




Ensure quality of tutor classes and complete the assigned syllabus within the scheduled time 


Use all the available teaching aids for better understanding and delivery of the units 


Ensure the benchmark for assistant lectures is achieved in the KPM’s at the end of the semester. 


Tutor specific academic subjects to individuals or small groups 


Monitor student’s attendance and progress 


Use pre-determined Institution resources to deliver the tutoring as outlined 




Lesson Preparation, Assessment & Examination Duties 




Design, develop and prepare and conduct face-to-face, online and cooperative programs as allocated that inspire strong discussions and keep students interested and engaged. 


Ensure that unit/course design and delivery comply with quality standards and regulations of the University and College 


Assist in the conduct of examinations (e.g., paper setting, marking, supervision and invigilation) 


Prepare and Submit DRMS in a timely manner 




 


Student Learning Experience 




Provide a high-quality learning experience to students, assisting them to achieve prescribed learning outcomes 


Supervise student projects and academic elements of field trips as and when required 


Supporting students’ extra-curricular activities 


Coordinate meetings and schedules with tutees as appropriate 




 


Research, Scholarship & Innovation: 




Engage in research, scholarly activity and/or innovation, subject to the approval of the Head of School 


Engage with other researchers internally, nationally & internationally to contribute to the research objectives of the respected School and Institutions research centres 


To engaged in subject and professional research development as required and relevant to support teaching activities 


Be active and recognized contributor to the subject association and relevant professional bodies. 




 


Curriculum Development: 




Develop & produce appropriate learning materials 


Responsible for designing and delivery of modules and assessment methods 


Develop course/unit materials of relevance to the highest quality for undergraduate programs. 


Designing and delivery of Curriculum




General Duties: 
• Attend and present at relevant conferences and share knowledge and insights gained with the other schools when required 
• Liaise closely with teaching, technical, and administration. 
• Taking administrative responsibilities as requested by your Head of School, Division, and Registrar 
• Participate in professional development activities to improve tutorial skills and continue to grow cultural competence. 
• Provide support as a team member in other operational activities as and when requires 
• Participate in Institutions’ staff development initiatives relating to learning & teaching. 


 


KEY SELECTION CRITERIA:


The following criteria are considered to be ESSENTIAL: 




Master’s Degree or Higher in any of the following fields: Business, Economics 


Has 3 years’ experience in Teaching business or economics courses. 


Well-developed interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with students and all levels of employees and management 


Excellent business judgment, analytical and decision-making skills 


Ability to review programme design on a regular basis to ensure compliance with quality standards and academic regulations and to make alterations where appropriate. 


Ability to demonstrate equivalent core knowledge in units taken 


Ability to use a range of delivery techniques to enthuse and engage students 


Capacity to develop and maintain effective working relationships with students, staff, management, other organizations and external stakeholders 


Ability to communicate and impart complex conceptual ideas in a variety of way – presentations, reports, journal articles etc. 


Ability to plan workloads and projects and manage resources effectively 


Sound Computer skills













    	        
Apply

Summary






The 
Employee Services Supervisor
 oversees daily HR support operations and ensures smooth coordination of employee-related services, including benefits administration, timekeeping, and employee inquiries. This role requires strong ERP knowledge to monitor and review employee data, synchronize working hours with team members, and provide timely reports to management. This position requires occasional travel (3-4 times per year) for training, HR meetings, and company-wide events.


Duties and Responsibilities








Supervise and coordinate remote employee services, ensuring efficient HR operations.


Monitor and review employee records, attendance, and payroll entries within the ERP system to ensure accuracy.


Ensure compliance with company policies, labor laws, and ISO standards.


Sync up working hours with remote team members to ensure seamless collaboration and availability.


Act as the primary point of contact for remote employees regarding HR policies, payroll queries, and workplace concerns.


Conduct virtual onboarding sessions and assist new hires with ERP system access and company policy understanding.


Prepare and submit timely reports on employee services performance, attendance trends, and HR compliance.


Support engagement initiatives such as online training, wellness programs, and performance evaluations.


Collaborate with HR leadership and IT teams to ensure remote employees have access to necessary HR tools and systems.


Travel for training, ERP system upgrades, and HR strategy meetings (3-4 times per year).




Job Requirements








Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.


Minimum 3-5 years of experience in HR services, employee relations, or HR administration.


In-depth knowledge of ERP systems (Odoo, SAP, Oracle, or similar) with hands-on experience managing HR modules.


Ability to monitor, review, and analyze employee records and HR data within the ERP system.


Strong communication skills with the ability to provide effective remote employee support.


Ability to sync up working hours across different time zones and ensure smooth coordination with the team.


Experience in HRIS, payroll management, and digital employee engagement tools.


Strong attention to detail and ability to detect errors in employee records.


Ability to generate timely reports and provide data-driven insights to management.


Willingness to travel for training and strategic HR meetings.

28562.description:
Summary






This position is responsible for managing the financial and contractual aspects of construction projects from planning to final handover. The role involves detailed cost estimation, tender preparation, contract administration, and project closeout, ensuring value for money and compliance at every stage.


Duties and Responsibilities






1. Pre-Construction Stage (Planning, Cost Estimation, and Contract Preparation)




Prepare feasibility studies and cost plans to assess project viability.


Develop preliminary and detailed cost estimates, covering material, labour, and associated costs.


Review drawings, Bills of Quantities (BOQ), Bills of Materials (BOM), take-offs and specifications.


Review design development and advise management on cost impact.


Support value engineering and recommend cost effective solutinos. 


Prepare and review tender documents and scope of works.


Evaluate contractor tenders/bids and prepare comparison and recommendations.


Negotiate prices and commercial terms with contractors and suppliers.


Propose cost-saving strategies and implement value engineering initiatives.


Ensure adherence to local regulations, statutory requirements, and internal standards.




2. Construction Stage (Contract Administration, Cost Control, and Monitoring)




Review and assess progressive claims, variations, and change orders.


Perform on-site inspections and quantity validations of completed works.


Prepare and issue interim payment certificates on a regular basis.


Coordinate with Project Manager, consultants, contractors and procurement team on commercial matters.


Manage disputes and contractual communication with external parties.


Monitor project cost against approved budget and identify possible cost overruns.




3. Post-Construction (Final Accounts and Closure)




Compile final accounts and close-out costs for each project.


Approve final subcontractor and supplier claims.


Ensure retention release and processing of all contractually required deductions.




4. Completion & Handover




Support final project handover activities and checklist completion.


Ensure receipt of all warranty documents, maintenance manuals, and as-built records.


Facilitate final regulatory approvals and statutory compliance certifications.




Job Requirements








Degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or Construction Management.


5–10 years’ experience in project cost control and contract administration.


Proficiency in tendering, cost planning, and post-contract activities.


Skilled in contract negotiation and commercial risk management.


Experience with construction measurement and cost software.


Strong leadership and team coordination capabilities.


Ability to manage multiple tasks under tight deadlines.


Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.




Travel from Project Office to Construction Sites may be required from time to time.

28561.description:
Summary






The selected candidate will oversee all accounting operations, including accounts payable, receivable, and financial reporting. This role involves managing a team of accountants to ensure accurate recording of financial transactions, compliance with tax regulations, and preparation of audit materials. S/he will specifically focus on accounting functions and collaborate with the Finance Department on related financial planning and analysis activities.


Duties and Responsibilities






1) Accounting Operations (AP, AR, GL)




Oversee accounts payable and receivable processes to ensure timely and accurate processing of payments, receipts, and allocations.


Ensure customer and vendor reconciliations are performed and reviewed, including monitoring of aging reports and follow-up actions.


Maintain accurate general ledger postings and ensure proper supporting documentation for all transactions.


Manage month-end close activities, including review of journals, accruals, prepayments, and account reconciliations.




2) Retail Accounting and POS Control




Ensure monthly billing and retail sales reporting is complete and accurate.


Reconcile point-of-sale (POS) data to accounting records and investigate variances with Retail Operations.


Monitor inventory accounting movements and support inventory turnover reporting and reconciliation.




3) Financial Reporting (Preparation and Accuracy)




Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in line with IFRS/GAAP and company policies.


Prepare monthly management reports, including P&L statements and key supporting schedules for review by the CFO/Financial Controller.


Ensure financial reports are complete, accurate, and supported by reconciliation schedules before submission for internal review.




4) Operational Financial Controls (Monitor and Escalate)




Implement and enforce accounting policies and procedures to safeguard assets and maintain financial integrity.


Ensure segregation of duties is applied within AP, AR, cash handling, POS processes, and journal approvals.


Review high-risk areas and exception items, including manual journal entries, credit notes, write-offs, adjustments, refunds, and unusual vendor/customer activity.


Perform variance and exception reviews (e.g., unusual movements, out-of-pattern transactions, repeated overrides) and document findings.


Escalate suspicious transactions, control breaches, or significant variances to the CFO/Financial Controller and support follow-up actions.


Support Internal Audit by providing documents, explanations, and evidence of control performance (without compromising audit independence).




5) Tax and Statutory Compliance




Ensure compliance with tax regulations, including preparation and filing of corporate tax returns, VAT/GST, and payroll-related taxes where applicable.


Maintain accurate tax working papers and coordinate with tax consultants and authorities as required.


Ensure adherence to applicable IAS and local regulatory requirements.




6) Audit Coordination and Close-Out




Serve as the main contact for external auditors for accounting matters.


Prepare audit schedules and provide supporting documents and explanations in a timely manner.


Track audit findings and implement agreed corrective actions within Finance to strengthen controls and improve compliance.




7) Systems, Process Improvement, and Data Integrity




Ensure accounting systems and processes are optimised for accuracy, efficiency, and proper access control.


Work with IT and relevant departments to improve integration between ERP/accounting systems and other platforms (including POS).


Maintain proper master data controls (customers, vendors, chart of accounts) and data integrity within systems.




8) Team Leadership and Capability Building




Lead and develop the accounting team to ensure effective delivery of daily operations and month-end close.


Assign responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure staff follow SOPs and control procedures.


Conduct performance reviews and provide coaching and training to improve skills and compliance.


Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, and professionalism within the department.




Job Requirements








CPA or ACCA or equivalent professional accounting certification (required).


Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (required).


Minimum 10 years of accounting experience, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or management role.


Proven experience managing AP, AR, general ledger, and month-end close.


Experience supporting retail accounting operations, including POS reconciliations and P&L reporting.


Experience supporting audits and implementing corrective actions from findings.


Strong knowledge of IFRS/GAAP, tax regulations, and audit requirements.


Proficiency with accounting software and ERP systems; familiarity with retail POS systems.


Strong skills in reconciliations, reporting, and operational control monitoring.


High attention to detail and strong quality control habits.


Strong leadership and team management capability.


Strong analytical skills with ability to identify exceptions and control issues.


Clear communication skills and ability to escalate issues with evidence and recommendations.


Strong organisation and ability to manage deadlines and multiple priorities.

28543.description:
TELEMU NO. 16 LOGISTICS AND PHARMACY LIMITED is currently looking
Position: LOGISTICS SUPERVISOR


General Description


The logistics supervisor is responsible for the effective coordination and supervision of the company’s daily logistics operations, including inventory, cargo handling, deliveries, dispatches, transportation, and coordination with suppliers, vendors, government offices, and other external parties.


The position ensures that all goods and cargo are properly received, stored, packaged, dispatched, transported, and delivered safely, accurately, and on time. The logistics supervisor is also responsible for supervising logistics personnel and providing regular updates and reports to management.


Key Duties and Responsibilities


1. Inventory and Warehouse




Receive, check, count, and organize cartons, materials, equipment, and other cargo.


Ensure all goods are properly stored, labelled, and arranged.


Conduct regular inventory counts and maintain accurate stock records.


Monitor stock levels and report shortages, excesses, damages, or discrepancies to management.


Ensure the warehouse and storage areas are clean, organized, and safe.


Ensure proper handling and storage of goods to prevent loss or damage.


Monitor the movement of cargo and materials in and out of the warehouse.




2. Delivery and Dispatch




Coordinate and supervise all routine deliveries and daily dispatches.


Plan and coordinate delivery schedules and transportation requirements.


Ensure all cargo is properly packed, labelled, counted, and secured before dispatch.


Supervise the loading and unloading of cargo.


Ensure the correct cargo is delivered to the correct destination.


Monitor deliveries and follow up with drivers until delivery is completed.


Ensure proof of delivery and other required documents are properly obtained and submitted.


Immediately report delivery delays, lost or damaged cargo, accidents, or other issues to management.




3. Cargo Handling and Transportation




Take responsibility for the proper handling and protection of cargo during transportation.


Ensure fragile, heavy, valuable, or special cargo is handled appropriately.


Coordinate with drivers regarding delivery routes, schedules, destinations, and special instructions.


Monitor the condition and availability of vehicles used for deliveries.


Report vehicle problems, accidents, or maintenance requirements to management.


Assist in improving delivery efficiency and minimizing transportation delays and costs.




4. Team Supervision




Supervise drivers, warehouse workers, helpers, and other logistics personnel.


Assign daily tasks and delivery responsibilities to team members.


Monitor attendance, work performance, discipline, and compliance with company policies.


Provide clear instructions and guidance to logistics staff.


Ensure team members properly follow company procedures and safety requirements.


Lead by example and maintain a professional, respectful, and positive working environment.




5. Vendor, Supplier, and Government Coordination




Coordinate with suppliers, contractors, external vendors, freight providers, and other service providers.


Act as a point of contact for assigned government offices and external vendors when required.


Coordinate and follow up on tenders and other logistics-related requirements as instructed by management.


Follow up on quotations, submissions, approvals, applications, registrations, and other related matters.


Maintain proper records of communications, submissions, and follow-ups.


Escalate unresolved issues or delays to management.




6. Reporting and Documentation




Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly logistics reports as required.


Provide management with regular updates on deliveries, dispatches, inventory, pending tasks, and operational issues.


Maintain accurate records of cargo received, dispatched, delivered, and returned.


Ensure all delivery, inventory, and logistics documents are properly completed and filed.


Report immediately any loss, damage, shortage, discrepancy, accident, or other incident involving company cargo or vehicles.




7. Safety and Compliance




Ensure safe loading, unloading, handling, storage, and transportation of cargo.


Ensure logistics personnel follow company safety procedures and use appropriate PPE where required.


Report accidents, injuries, vehicle incidents, cargo damage, and safety concerns immediately.


Ensure all logistics activities comply with company policies, procedures, and applicable requirements.




8. Management Support




Carry out reasonable and lawful instructions given by management.


Provide timely updates on assigned tasks and pending matters.


Coordinate with management before making decisions involving significant costs, operational risks, or major delays.


Identify logistics problems and recommend practical solutions.


Perform other logistics-related duties as may be assigned by management from time to time.




Qualifications and Experience




Minimum 
Grade 12 qualification
.


Minimum 
2–3 years of relevant experience
 in logistics, transportation, warehouse, supply chain, or a similar supervisory role.


Previous experience supervising drivers, warehouse staff, or logistics personnel is preferred.


Experience in inventory management, cargo handling, delivery coordination, and dispatch operations.


Basic knowledge of logistics documentation and warehouse procedures.


Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and other relevant systems.


A valid driver's license is an advantage.




Skills and Competencies


The successful candidate must have:




Strong organizational and coordination skills.


Good communication and interpersonal skills.


Good leadership and team supervision skills.


Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.


Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.


Ability to multitask and prioritize work.


Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.


Good attention to detail.


Ability to monitor and follow up tasks until completion.


Ability to communicate effectively with management, employees, drivers, suppliers, vendors, and government representatives.


Good knowledge of cargo handling and delivery procedures.


Ability to prepare accurate reports and maintain proper records.




Personal Attributes


The candidate must be:




Honest and trustworthy.


Responsible, reliable, and accountable.


Professional and respectful.


Punctual and disciplined.


Proactive and willing to take initiative.


Flexible and adaptable to changing operational requirements.


Calm and professional when dealing with unexpected problems.


A good role model for colleagues and team members.


Committed to teamwork and maintaining good working relationships.


Willing to follow company policies, procedures, and management instructions.

28493.description:
PLUMBER WANTED!!!!!


PNG BROTHERS CONSTRUCTION LIMITED


ARE YOU A PLUMBER… OR JUST A GUY WHO KNOWS WHERE TO TURN OFF THE TAP?


PNG Brothers Construction Limited is looking for a 
REAL PLUMBER
.


Not someone whose solution to every plumbing problem is:




“Boss, we need a new pipe.”
 




Not someone who sees a leaking pipe and says,




“It was not leaking when I came yesterday.”
 




And definitely NOT someone who fixes a leak by putting a bucket underneath it and calling the job 
“completed.”
 


 IF YOU CAN DO THIS… WE WANT YOU!




FIX A LEAK
 without creating three new leaks.


INSTALL A SHOWER
 that actually produces water.


FIX A TOILET
 without making everyone afraid to use it afterward. 


CONNECT PIPES
 without turning the building into a swimming pool.


MEASURE PROPERLY
 instead of saying, 
“Boss, I think this one will fit.”


INSTALL FITTINGS
 that don't start leaking five minutes after you leave.


UNDERSTAND HOT AND COLD WATER
 — because apparently they are not the same thing.




And most importantly…


KNOW WHERE THE WATER SHUT-OFF VALVE IS!


Because when everyone is shouting:




“TURN OFF THE WATER!!!”




We don't want you standing there looking at the pipe like it's going to introduce itself. 


 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING




Install, repair and maintain water supply and drainage systems.


 Install pipes, valves, fittings, fixtures and plumbing equipment.


 Install and repair toilets, sinks, showers, taps and other plumbing fixtures.


Perform plumbing works for construction, renovation and building projects.


 Read basic plumbing drawings, plans and measurements.


 Cut, thread, bend, join and install pipes and fittings.


Test plumbing systems for leaks, pressure and proper operation.


Troubleshoot blockages, leaks and plumbing problems.


Coordinate with carpenters, masons, electricians, painters and other trades.


 Keep the work area clean and safe.


Report defective materials, damaged tools, hazards and other site problems.




WHAT WE EXPECT




 Minimum 
2 years' experience
 as a Plumber or in a similar construction role.


Experience in building construction, plumbing installation, repair and maintenance.


Good knowledge of pipes, fittings, valves, fixtures and plumbing materials.


Ability to read basic drawings and measurements.


Ability to diagnose and repair plumbing problems.


Able to use plumbing hand tools and equipment safely.


Physically fit and capable of construction work.


Able to work independently and as part of a team.


Plumbing trade certification or formal training is an advantage.




 BEFORE YOU APPLY…


Let's have a little test. 


Can you answer 
YES
 to these?




 Can you find a water leak without following the sound of dripping water like a detective?


 Can you fix a leaking pipe 
without making the leak worse?


 Can you repair a toilet without saying:




“Boss, we need to remove the whole toilet.”
 


 Can you tell the difference between 
“low water pressure”
 and 
“there is no water because nobody paid the bill”?
 




 Can you install a tap that doesn't leak?

About Us


With a mission to enhance the efficiency and performance of every business, Odoo offers all-in-one open-source software covering 60+ business applications such as Sales, Accounting, Manufacturing, Inventory, and more. It's flexible for businesses of all scales and industries, and with prices 3x more affordable than other conventional competitors (such as SAP and Microsoft), Odoo effortlessly becomes the preferred choice for entrepreneurs across Indonesia!


You think it's too good to be true? See for yourself. 
Preview our 1-click demo.
 


Start a career with us. We offer you an extraordinary chance to learn and grow. Be involved with a very exciting product and a great team behind it.


Responsibilities


About the Role


As our Partner Growth & Enablement Executive for Implementing Partners, you’ll be the main bridge between our company and our ecosystem of ERP partners. Your mission is to help them grow (sales revenue, product knowledge, and software implementations), stay aligned with our standards/rules, and deliver successful ERP projects for their clients.


You’ll work closely with partners to ensure they’re meeting their KPIs, for examples: number of new users acquired. On top of that, supported in their business goals, and equipped with the right tools to thrive — all while maintaining strong, strategic relationships built on trust and performance.


If you enjoy helping others succeed while driving business results, this role is made for you.


What You'll Do




Drive sales growth through implementing partners, ensuring they meet or exceed assigned revenue targets and KPIs.


Build and execute joint business plans with each partner — aligning on goals, sales strategies, and target markets.


Regularly review partner pipelines, identify opportunities, and provide guidance to accelerate deal closures.

Monitor and report on partner sales performance, forecast accuracy, and activity levels.


Collaborate with the Partner Manager and internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Technical) to enable and empower partners for success.


Maintain high standards of partner performance — balancing support and accountability.


Represent the voice of partners internally, ensuring they have the right tools and resources to grow.




MUST HAVE




Min. Bachelor degree or higher


Fluent in English


3–5+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, channel/partner management, or ERP/SaaS solution sales.,


Strong understanding of business processes (finance, sales, inventory, manufacturing, etc.) and variety of business models (service companies, retail companies)


Proven track record in driving revenue and growth through parners or resellers


Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.


Analytical and KPI-driven mindset — comfortable working with numbers, forecasts, and performance dashboards.


Proactive and organized, with a high sense of ownership and accountability.


Highly proactive, result-oriented, and comfortable owning sales targets.


Willing to relocate to Indonesia




NICE TO HAVE




Understanding of ERP implementation lifecycles and common partner challenges


Ability to lead workshops or training session.


Strong market knowledge of the Papua New Guinea area


Immediate availability

28398.description:
Summary






The holder of this position will be crucial in managing surveying activities and utilizing advanced equipment and software like Civil CAD to support property development projects. The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, significant experience in infrastructure project management, a strong background in surveying techniques and equipment operation, and a proven track record of working on property development projects. Additionally, the candidate must possess excellent problem-solving skills to identify challenges, propose solutions, and resolve issues amicably.


Duties and Responsibilities








Property Development Project Management:




Manage surveying activities for property development projects, ensuring adherence to project timelines, budgets, and quality standards.


Collaborate with the property development team, architects, and contractors to integrate surveying requirements into the overall project plan.


Conduct site visits to assess feasibility, identify potential challenges, and propose solutions to support the property development process.


Utilize problem-solving skills to address any issues that may arise during the project, seeking amicable resolutions.






Surveying and Contour Plan Design:




Utilize survey equipment, such as total stations, GPS receivers, and 3D laser scanners, to conduct accurate measurements and collect data related to topography, boundaries, and existing structures.


Analyze survey data and utilize specialized software, including Civil CAD software, to generate precise contour plans in both 2D and 3D formats.


Collaborate with architects and engineers to incorporate survey data into property development designs and plans, ensuring accurate positioning and alignment.


Employ problem-solving techniques to overcome any challenges encountered during the surveying and contour plan design process.






Data Analysis and Reporting:




Process and analyze survey data using advanced software tools, including Civil CAD software, to identify patterns, trends, and potential issues related to the property development project.


Prepare comprehensive reports and documentation of survey findings, including technical drawings, charts, and graphical representations.


Communicate survey results to the property development team and stakeholders, providing clear explanations, recommendations, and addressing any concerns or queries.


Utilize problem-solving skills to propose alternative solutions or modifications when data analysis reveals potential issues or discrepancies.






Equipment Maintenance and Calibration:




Ensure proper maintenance and calibration of survey equipment to guarantee accurate measurements and reliable performance.


Coordinate equipment repairs or replacements as needed, minimizing downtime and disruptions to surveying activities.


Stay updated with the latest advancements in surveying technology and recommend equipment upgrades to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.


Apply problem-solving abilities to troubleshoot equipment issues and find suitable solutions.






Regulatory Compliance:




Ensure compliance with relevant surveying regulations, codes, and standards in property development projects.


Stay informed about local zoning regulations, land surveying laws, and environmental requirements to ensure adherence during the surveying process.


Collaborate with legal and regulatory bodies, as necessary, to obtain necessary permits and approvals.


Utilize problem-solving skills to navigate regulatory challenges and propose compliant solutions.








Job Requirements








Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.


Proven experience as a Surveying Engineer, with a focus on civil infrastructure projects.


Strong knowledge of land surveying principles, techniques, and equipment.


Proficiency in using surveying software, such as CAD and GIS applications.


Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.


Strong attention to detail and ability to produce accurate and reliable survey data.


Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and clients.


Project management abilities, including the capacity to prioritize tasks, manage resources, and meet project deadlines.


Familiarity with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards related to land surveying.


Professional licensure or certification as a Land Surveyor is preferred.




Others








Ability to work in outdoor environments and adverse weather conditions, including extreme temperatures.


Physical fitness and endurance to conduct field surveys, including walking long distances, climbing, and carrying equipment.


Ability to lift and transport surveying equipment and tools.




Work in both field and office settings. Fieldwork involves conducting land surveys and data collection on-site, which may require travel to various locations. The work environment may include exposure to varying temperatures, rugged terrains, and other environmental factors.


The position may require travel to project sites, client meetings, and occasional overnight stays. Travel frequency and duration will vary depending on project demands.

27876.description:
Job Type:
 
Permanent
 
About us 


K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate. 


We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.


About the role


This position is responsible for the service and maintenance of heavy surface equipment in a safe and appropriate manner. This includes Volvo Trucks, Front-end loaders, Dozers, Mobile cranes (45T & 100T), and other pieces of equipment.


Key Accountabilities




Undertaking scheduled servicing and preventative maintenance of the company's heavy vehicle fleet, including Volvo, CAT and Normet vehicles and equipment.


Respond to machinery breakdowns promptly and undertake quality repairs in a timely manner.


Servicing and preventative maintenance on Jumbos, Loaders and Trucks.


Diagnosis and troubleshooting of faults, and recommending servicing interventions that improve the operational efficiency of the company's heavy vehicle fleet


Rectifying machinery breakdowns in an underground environment promptly and undertake quality repairs in a timely manner.


Ensuring completion of all shift paperwork including service sheets, work orders and daily shift reports.


Completing all JSA's, risk assessments and documentation to ensure all work is completed safely and as per schedule. 


Give direction, coaching and technical assistance to Trade Assistant’s and apprentice.




About You 


Qualifications & Experience


To be considered for this role, it is essential that you must have a NATTB certified Trade Certificate in Heavy Equipment Fitting with 3+ years’ experience in mining environment or heavy construction industry. In addition to this, you will have




Experience with Mining Equipment like LHD Loaders, Caterpillar Equipment, Volvo Equipment etc.


Experience fitter with hydraulics training background.


Experience in the use of Pronto will be advantageous.


Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.


Excellent trouble shooting skills.


Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.


Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.


Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.


Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.




Life at K92  


K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.


Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.


At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.


In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster. 


THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP 





    	        
Apply

29039.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE


Based in the Head Office, Port Moresby and reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the IT Security Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining the organization's information security strategy, policies, standards, and controls to protect business information assets, systems, networks, and customer data. The role ensures compliance with regulatory requirements, manages cybersecurity risks, responds to security incidents, and promotes a strong security culture across the company.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES




Develop and maintain the Information Security Framework, governance processes, and reporting to ensure compliance, effective risk management, and alignment with business objectives.


Oversee cybersecurity operations, including security monitoring & incident management, vulnerability management, security tools, and regular security assessments to maintain a strong security posture.


Coordinate cybersecurity risk management and compliance activities, including risk assessments, regulatory compliance, audits, and remediation of security findings.


Oversee vulnerability management, including VAPT, remediation, patching, system hardening, and security configuration reviews.


Ensure infrastructure and network security across on-premises and cloud environments are secure.


Oversee identity and access management, including user access controls, privileged access, authentication, authorization, and access reviews.


Develop and deliver cybersecurity awareness and training programs to promote security best practices and a strong security culture across the organisation.


Oversee third-party security risk management, including vendor due diligence, security assessments, and contractual security requirements.


Support business continuity and disaster recovery by maintaining and testing recovery capabilities, backup security, and cyber resilience measures.




REQUIREMENTS




Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, a Master’s degree is an advantage.


At least 7 years of work experience in ICT with at least 3 years specifically within information security or cybersecurity management.


Experience in banking, financial services, fintech, or another regulated industry is preferred.


Proven experience managing security incidents, ransomware recovery, and enterprise security technologies.


Experience managing VAPT engagements and audit remediation programs.


Demonstrated expertise in cybersecurity operations.


Strong knowledge of cybersecurity risk and compliance frameworks, business continuity, and disaster recovery planning.


Relevant professional cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent Microsoft, Azure, or AWS security certifications.




HOW TO APPLY


If you are passionate about pursuing a career with Moni Plus and enjoy being part of a high-performing support team, we’d love to hear from you. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, including health insurance, and professional development opportunities.


Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and why you are the ideal candidate for this position.


Address your application to: 


Head of Human Capital, Moni Plus, PO Box 1748, Boroko, NCD via email 
[email protected]
 and apply now.


Applications close 
Friday, 30 October 2026. 
Please note, only shortlisted applicants will be contacted to proceed.

28988.description:
Goodman Fielder Papua New Guinea is one of PNG’s largest food companies, manufacturing and distributing high-quality Flour, Stock Feed, Rice, Snacks, and Bakery products throughout the country. Well-known products and brands include Flame Flour, Flame Stockfeed, Flame Oil & Sugar, Flame Rice, Bilas Bread, Skel Rice, Twisties snacks, Arthurs Pies, and the Meadow Lea range.


At GFI, we care about making food better for everyone.


Our goal is to be the leading and most innovative food company with a mission to meet our customers’ needs for superior quality foods with brands that are trusted by families everywhere.  We are the go-to source of consumer, shopper, and customer insights to help our customer and business partners succeed.


Position Purpose:


The Trade, Imports Procurement & Sales Specialist is responsible for identifying, sourcing, evaluating, importing, launching, and growing new products that complement Goodman Fielder PNG's existing portfolio. The role will actively identify international supplier and product opportunities, negotiate commercial agreements, manage import processes, and drive sales performance of imported products within the PNG market. The position serves as the key link between suppliers, procurement, logistics, marketing, customer service, and the sales team to ensure profitable growth through the development of a sustainable imported products portfolio that meets consumer, trade, and customer needs.


We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven 
Trade, Imports Procurement & Sales Specialist 
to join our Trade Marketing team based in 
Port Moresby
. Reporting to the 
Trade Marketing Manager
, this role will play a key part in driving national trade execution across Modern Trade, General Trade, and Outstation markets, ensuring consistent execution of trade marketing initiatives and sales growth strategies.


Key Responsibilities:


Product Sourcing & Business Development




Identify new product opportunities from international markets that align with GFI PNG's strategic growth objectives.


Conduct market research to identify consumer trends, category opportunities and supply gaps within PNG. 


Develop and maintain relationships with overseas manufacturers, suppliers, distributors and trading partners.


Evaluate new products based on market potential, profitability, product quality, regulatory requirements and strategic fit.


Present business cases and commercial recommendations for new product introductions.




Procurement & Supplier Management 




Source and negotiate competitive pricing, supply agreements and trading terms with international suppliers.


Manage supplier performance, service levels, product quality and contractual obligations.


Develop and maintain supplier scorecards and performance reviews.


Monitor global commodity and freight market movements that may impact product costs.


Identify alternative sourcing options to ensure continuity of supply.




Import Management




Coordinate import activities from order placement through to delivery into PNG.


Work closely with logistics, supply chain and customs partners to ensure efficient product flow.


Ensure compliance with PNG import regulations, labelling requirements and food safety standards.


Manage documentation including purchase orders, shipping documents, permits and customs clearance requirements.


Monitor inventory levels and recommend purchasing plans to minimise stock-outs and overstock situations.




Sales & Portfolio Management




Develop sales strategies for imported products.


Establish sales forecasts, margin targets and growth plans.


Collaborate with regional sales teams to drive customer acquisition and product penetration.


Monitor sales performance and implement corrective actions where required.


Conduct regular customer visits to identify opportunities and strengthen business relationships.




Commercial Analysis




Prepare profitability analysis, pricing recommendations and return-on-investment assessments.


Monitor landed cost calculations and margin performance.


Develop business cases for new product launches and range extensions.


Provide monthly sales, procurement and profitability reports.


Track competitor pricing, promotions and new market developments.




Marketing & Product Launch Support




Work with Marketing and Trade Marketing teams to support product launches.


Assist in the development of promotional programs and customer activation plans.


Provide product training to the sales team and key customers.


Support the creation of marketing materials and product positioning strategies.




Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


Financial




Imported product sales revenue.


Gross profit achievement.


Portfolio margin performance.


New product contribution to total sales.


Cost savings achieved through procurement negotiations.




Commercial




Number of successful product launches. 


New supplier acquisition.


Market share growth of imported portfolio.


Customer distribution and penetration targets.




Operational 




Inventory management performance.


Forecast accuracy.


Supplier service level compliance.


Import lead time performance.


Product availability.




Qualifications & Experience Essential




Bachelor's Degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Supply Chain, Procurement or a related discipline.


Minimum 3-5 years' experience in FMCG, procurement, trading, imports, sales or category management.


Proven experience negotiating with suppliers and customers.


Strong commercial and financial analysis capabilities.


Experience managing supplier relationships and procurement activities




Be part of the Skel life and join a team that values healthy eating and active lifestyles and wants to share that with all the people of PNG.  Still interested? Send your letter of application and CV/resume with at least 2 referees to:


The Recruitment Team


Goodman Fielder Papua New Guinea


P O. Box 673, Port Moresby NCD PNG


E-mail: 
[email protected]


Please submit your application in PDF and in 
only one attachment
. 


Applications close 
30th Friday October 2026.


Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.





            

        
Apply

GIS Geologist
 to join our Geology and Exploration team on Woodlark Island.


The GIS Geologist will provide GIS, spatial data management, geological mapping, and technical support to exploration and resource development activities. The role will work closely with Geologists, Survey, Mine Technical Services, Environmental, and other site teams.


Key Responsibilities




Manage and maintain geological GIS databases and spatial datasets.


Produce geological, structural, geochemical, drilling, exploration, topographic, and tenement maps.


Integrate geological, geochemical, geophysical, drilling, survey, and field data.


Provide GIS support for exploration planning, geological mapping, sampling, and drilling programmes.


Undertake spatial analysis to support geological interpretation and exploration targeting.


Prepare maps, figures, plans, and GIS outputs for technical reports and management presentations.


Maintain high standards of data accuracy, QA/QC, metadata, and database integrity.

28913.description:
Don’t come for an easy career. Stay for a rewarding one.
 


Santos is a global energy company committed to increasingly cleaner energy and fuels production, with operations across Australia, Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste and North America.  


  


We are currently PNG’s largest single investor and most active explorer, operating all the country’s producing oil fields and holding an extensive appraisal and exploration portfolio. Our aspirations and strategies reflect our genuine commitment to making a meaningful contribution to the lives of Papua New Guineans. 


 


At Santos, our commitment is to be a global leader in the transition to cleaner energy and clean fuels, by helping the world decarbonise to reach net-zero emissions in an affordable and sustainable way.  


           


Santos is one of Australia’s biggest domestic gas supplier, a leading Asia Pacific LNG supplier and is committed to supplying the critical fuels such as oil and gas in a more sustainable way through decarbonising projects such as the Moomba CCS project. 


   


For more than 65 years, Santos has been working in partnership with local communities, providing local jobs and business opportunities, safely and sustainably developing its natural gas resources, and powering industries and households. 


 


What you’ll do:


Based at Iagifu Ridge, Kutubu in the Southern Highlands Province, PNG, this is a Fly-In, Fly-Out (FIFO) role that forms part of the Central Maintenance team. The Senior Instrument & Electrical Technician ensures the safe, timely and effective execution of preventive and corrective maintenance, as well as the installation of Instrumentation and Electrical (I&E) systems across Santos PNG Oil and Gas Field Operation sites. These sites encompass wellheads, export flowlines and metering, processing facilities, Solar turbine-driven power generation and gas compression units, and camp facilities. The role drives high-quality, on-schedule planned and unplanned maintenance work alongside a diverse, multi-skilled I&E team and contractors, while balancing cost, production and delivery priorities.


  


Key accountabilities include:




Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on wellheads, export flowlines and metering, processing facilities, Solar Turbine driven power generation and gas compression units, and camp facilities to ensure optimal performance.


Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on fixed and portable diesel engine generators, lighting plants, mobile air compressors and general electrical and instrument equipment.


Plan, prepare and execute equipment isolations across high voltage, low voltage, mechanical and process systems.


Perform hazardous area inspections and provide accurate reports in a timely manner.


Effectively diagnose, troubleshoot and complete electrical and instrument routine and non-routine tasks.


Accurate and timely submission of planned maintenance reports, calibration certificates and inspection sheets.


Offer mentoring and skills development to other team members.


Adhere to Santos control of work, permitting and isolation procedures.


Escalate defects, non-compliances and delays to supervision in a timely manner.


Utilise SAP to raise notifications, check materials, time write and close out work orders in line with the Santos work management process.


Report all incidents (safety, environmental or operational) and comply with the Santos Management System (SMS) and Santos values, behaviours and lifesaving rules at all times.




  


What you’ll bring:


To be successful in this role, you will bring:




Five years post-trade electrical and instrument experience in mining, oil and gas or other heavy industry.


Extensive trade experience maintaining Solar Turbines or equivalent engines, compressors and generators.


Extensive trade experience maintaining fixed and portable diesel generators and controls, remote area power systems and UPS.


Trade experience maintaining and switching of HV and LV electrical systems.


Detailed knowledge of routine maintenance and installation of electrical and instrument equipment relevant to oil and gas facilities.


Experience maintaining, installing and inspecting hazardous area equipment (EEHA).


Ability to interpret electrical drawings, instrument loop drawings, datasheets, wiring diagrams, PLC diagrams, P&IDs and C&E charts.


Experience calibrating instrument equipment using a Beamex calibrating device or equivalent.


Proficiency with Microsoft applications and SAP.


Excellent oral and written communication skills.




 


You will hold a current Electrical Licence and current Driving Licence (both mandatory), along with an Instrument Trade Certificate. Desirable qualifications include an HV Switching Certificate, EEHA 5-day Operating and Maintaining certification, and a Certificate IV in Training and Assessment.


 


What you’ll get: 


Here, you’ll be amongst high-calibre people and get to work on industry-leading projects. We don’t shy away from solving tough problems at pace. We like it that way. You can expect to be challenged and supported; to learn and grow.


 


At Santos, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. This means a place that is safe; where you are valued and respected, and your contribution is recognised and appreciated. Join us, and you’ll play a role in this too.


 


Each of our sites offer access to specific amenities that aim to create the best possible benefits to your health, wellbeing and performance.


 


What you’re part of:


Everywhere you turn you will be a part of a team who are coming together to contribute to our single uniting purpose  - to provide reliable and affordable energy to help create a better world for everyone And because it’s not only what you do, but how you do it, you will also contribute to improving the living standards of the communities where we operate, building enduring and respectful relationships that serve a generation. It’s about each of us, and all of us – together.


 


How to Apply


Applications must be submitted via the online recruitment system before 
COB Friday 30
th
 October 2026
.  


 


A requirement of this role is that you will need to have in place the legal work rights for PNG to apply. 


  


Potential Scams


There are a number of fake adverts that are impersonating Santos Limited, in these instances you will receive an e-mail from a generic e-mail address. We do not make offers without interviews or due diligence taking place.  You will know if an advert is genuine if you are directed to the Santos company careers page to apply which is 
https://recruitment.santos.com/


 





    	        
Apply

Position Title: Boiler Operator


Location: Madang 


Division: Globe


 


Overview
We are seeking a skilled and safety-conscious Boiler Operator to ensure the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of our site’s boiler systems and associated utilities. You will be responsible for maintaining continuous steam supply to production lines, monitoring boiler parameters, performing routine maintenance, and ensuring compliance with PNG safety regulations and internal policies.


 


Key Responsibilities
Boiler Operation & Monitoring: Operate, monitor, and control boiler systems to ensure consistent steam supply for production. Conduct routine checks on pressure, temperature, water levels, fuel supply, and safety devices.


Record Keeping: Record operational data in logbooks and digital systems. Maintain accurate maintenance records, daily logs, and incident reports.


Water Treatment & Quality Control: Monitor and maintain boiler water quality, including chemical dosing and blowdown procedures. Conduct water tests to prevent scaling, corrosion, and carryover.


Maintenance & Repairs: Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on boilers, feed pumps, valves, burners, and water treatment systems. Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control issues affecting boiler performance.


Safety & Compliance: Ensure all boiler operations comply with PNG safety regulations and internal policies. Maintain and test safety valves, alarms, gauges, and emergency shutdown systems.


Communication & Coordination: Report abnormalities, breakdowns, and potential risks to the Utilities Supervisor. Liaise with production teams and maintenance staff to coordinate shutdowns and repairs.


Cross-Functional Support: Assist with other utilities systems such as air compressors, generators, and refrigeration units when required.

PNG Boiler Operator Certification (Class 1 or Class 2) is essential.


Minimum 3 years’ experience operating industrial boilers (fire-tube or water-tube).


Strong understanding of boiler safety standards and water treatment processes.


Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) regulations.


Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, gauges, and instrumentation.


Good verbal and written communication skills.

Work Environment


Industrial manufacturing setting with exposure to heat, steam, noise, and rotating machinery.

28816.description:
Looking for a Change?


Join CARE International in PNG and be part of an organisation that serves the needs of Papua New Guineans living in remote PNG.


EXTERNAL RECRUITMENT


Project Manager-Peacebuilding Project –Enga Based


 
CARE International in PNG is looking into recruiting a suitable candidate for a Project Manager role under its Peacebuilding Project based in Wabag, Enga. CARE is an international development and humanitarian aid organisation fighting global poverty, with a special focus on working with women and girls to bring lasting change to their communities. As a non-religious and non-political organisation, CARE works with communities to help overcome poverty by supporting development efforts and providing emergency assistance. We believe supporting women and girls is one of the most effective ways to create sustainable outcomes in poor communities.


CARE International in Papua New Guinea has a focus on Gender Equality, Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR), Climate Change Adaptation (CCA), Agriculture and Health.


The Project Manager (PM) has overall responsibility for the implementation of the Project. The PM will oversee new peacebuilding programming in the Enga Province across seven communities, aimed at building social cohesion and reducing causes and impact of conflict. The PM will have overall responsibility for planning and reporting, budget management, donor liaison, community and stakeholder relationships as well as ensuring that project outputs are achieved in the agreed timeframe.


This position has two direct report and is expected to pursue a clear and compelling vision and motivate high performance. This position is based in Goroka but will require frequent trips to Enga Province.


Experience and Qualifications




Minimum bachelor’s in international development, International Relations or Peacebuilding required. Significant experience may substitute for some education and/or minimum of 5-7 years of relevant field-based experience in co-ordinating or managing light to moderately complex projects required with an international NGO;


Project management experience in peacebuilding is highly desirable;


Demonstrated experience engaging with partner organisations at a high level;


Demonstrated ability to develop technical proposals;


Strong critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills with ability to make sound judgment;


Relationship management skills and the ability to work effectively with culturally diverse groups;


Demonstrated Monitoring Evaluation and Learning skills and experience with MEL frameworks preferred;


Demonstrated ability to represent the organisation with high level external audiences


Must be proactive, results-oriented, and service-oriented;


Demonstrated thorough understanding of gender equality and a commitment to CARE’s approach and values including ethnic diversity and cultural sensitivity


Demonstrated high level organisational and time management skills, including the ability to plan and manage workflows and balance competing priorities to ensure timely processing to meet deadlines in a complex environment;


Strong leadership, decision making, problem solving, planning, analytical and influencing skills;


Experience using MS Windows and MS Office packages (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Web Conferencing Applications, information management systems; and


Fluent oral and written communication skills in both Pidgin and English, with ability to write reports for




Please note that Recruitment will be conducted on a rolling basis. Applications will be assessed as they are received, and CARE PNG reserves the right to close the recruitment process once a suitable candidate has been identified.


The closing date for this position is Friday 30th October 2026


For more information, get full position description and terms and condition here: 
PD_Peace Building Project Manager.pdf
 and

To be considered for this role please address the selection criteria in a letter of application also clearly state what location you are applying for and include a Resume (CV) with 3 referees and supporting documents via email: 
[email protected]
 or Mail to; P.O Box 1157, Goroka, 441 EHP


Only shortlisted candidates will be call for an Interview


CARE PNG is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages women to apply.


CARE PNG is committed to safeguarding children and the Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse.


CARE PNG does not tolerate gender-based violence and is committed to ensuring that Women, Men, Girls, and Boys live a LIFE FREE FROM VIOLENCE

Position: 
Procurement Coordinator
Company: 
Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited
Location: 
Port Moresby


 


Reinhold Engineering and Group of Companies Limited is a nationally owned civil works and building construction company based in Port Moresby. As we continue to grow and strengthen our operations across Papua New Guinea, we are seeking a capable and experienced Procurement Coordinator to lead our end-to-end procurement processes.


 


About the Role


The Procurement Coordinator is responsible for executing end-to-end procurement activities in accordance with our company policies, regulatory requirements, and timely, cost-effective, and compliant acquisition of goods and services to support operational and project requirements. This role serve as the primary liaison between internal departments, approved vendors, and the Finance department.


 


This position is well suited to an individual who is organized, confidential, and capable of operating in a fast-paced construction and project-based environment.


 


Key Responsibilities




Coordinate procurement operations with vendors and stakeholders.


Process purchase requisitions and issued purchase orders in a timely and accurate manner.


Obtain and evaluate quotations from approved suppliers to ensure competitive pricing, quality, and delivery terms.


Draft sourcing schedules based on project plans.


Gather data on vendor performance to propose improvements.


Gather feedback on the effectiveness and efficiency of current sourcing strategies.


Highlight sourcing issues for management’s action.


Maintain procurement database and records.


Ensure all procurement activities adhere to the Company’s internal Procurement Policy, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements.


Maintain and update vendor database, ensuring all compliance documentation is current and valid.


Manage vendors’ conformance to delivery schedules and product specifications.


Track vendor performance metrics and report on delivery reliability, quality, and responsiveness.


Address supplier inquiries and manage routine communications regarding orders, invoices, and delivery matters.


Assist in budget tracking and cost control initiatives within the procurement function.


Provide Weekly and Monthly Reports


Other duties in line with the role as required by Management.




 


 


Qualifications & Requirements


 


Education & Certification




Bachelor’s degree in business administration, commerce, or a related discipline.


Minimum of 2 years experience as a Procurement Coordinator in the construction industry.


Minimum of 5 years experience in Procurement/Supply Chain in the construction industry


Proficient in MS Office Suite, specifically Excel, Word and Outlook. Experience with and ERP system would be an advantage.


Demonstrated understanding of procurement principles, purchasing processes, and vendor management.




 


 


Essential Skills & Competencies




Exceptional leadership and team management abilities, with a focus on mentoring and developing talent.


Superior communication, negotiation, and vendor relationship management skills.


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.


Ability to multi-task and strong delegation skills.




 


What We Offer




Competitive remuneration package


Opportunity to contribute to a growing nationally owned company


Professional and respectful working environment


Opportunity to play a key role in strengthening organizational systems

28741.description:
An outstanding opportunity exists for an experienced 
Senior Account Director or senior marketing professional
 to take ownership of a major corporate account in Papua New Guinea.
This is a highly visible, relationship-driven role combining 
brand strategy, marketing strategy, senior stakeholder management and integrated campaign delivery
.
Rather than managing a broad portfolio of accounts, you will become deeply embedded in a major client relationship, developing a detailed understanding of its business, brand, customers and commercial priorities and translating these into effective marketing strategies, campaigns and projects.
You will act as the central connection between senior client stakeholders and a substantial multidisciplinary team spanning 
strategy, creative, digital, social, production and project delivery
.
The Role
Working closely with senior marketing and executive stakeholders, you will take ownership of the strategic and day-to-day relationship with a major corporate client.
Some projects will arrive with clearly defined briefs. In other situations, you will work with stakeholders to take an initial business objective or idea and develop it into a structured marketing strategy, campaign or project.
You will be expected to listen, interpret, advise and appropriately challenge thinking while ensuring projects are successfully executed.
With numerous campaigns and projects running concurrently, this role requires someone who can combine strategic thinking with strong organisation and the ability to make things happen.
Key Responsibilities




Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior marketing and executive stakeholders.


Develop a deep understanding of the client's business strategy, brand, customers and commercial priorities.


Provide strategic marketing and brand advice.


Translate business objectives into clear marketing initiatives, campaigns and briefs.


Bring proactive ideas, insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.


Lead projects from initial concept and briefing through to execution and delivery.


Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across strategy, creative, digital, social, production and project management.


Manage multiple campaigns, projects and competing priorities simultaneously.


Ensure briefs, responsibilities, timelines and expectations are clearly understood.


Maintain high standards of quality, timeliness and client service.


Resolve issues quickly and practically as priorities change.


Provide clear direction to internal teams while maintaining focus on the broader commercial objectives.


Support an increasingly regional relationship involving PNG, Australia and other Pacific markets.




About You
This opportunity will particularly suit an experienced 
Account Director, Senior Account Director or Group Account Director
 with a strong background in marketing, advertising, creative, brand or integrated agency environments.
Senior client-side marketing professionals with significant agency exposure may also be considered.
Ideally, you will bring:




Senior account management or marketing leadership experience.


Experience managing major corporate accounts and senior stakeholders.


Strong knowledge of brand and marketing strategy.


Experience delivering integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns.


The ability to coordinate substantial multidisciplinary teams.


Excellent project management and organisational capability.


Confidence managing a significant volume of concurrent work.


Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of account performance and client retention.


The ability to engage credibly with senior executives.


Financial services or banking sector exposure would be advantageous, but is not essential.




You will be 
strategic but practical, commercially astute, highly organised and an outstanding relationship builder
. You will be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment and confident taking genuine ownership of a major client relationship.
Location & Expatriate Package The position will ultimately be based in 
Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea
 and will be a residential rather than FIFO appointment.
There may be some flexibility for the successful candidate to initially commence from Australia while becoming familiar with the account and broader team before transitioning permanently to PNG.
A comprehensive expatriate package will be provided, including:




Competitive salary


Furnished accommodation in a secure compound


Vehicle for 24/7 use


Annual leave flight allowance


PNG health insurance


Phone and internet


Schooling support, if required


Work permit and immigration support




The position will also involve regular engagement with colleagues in Australia and may include periodic travel within Australia and the wider Pacific.
Why Consider This Opportunity?
This is an opportunity to move beyond conventional account management and take genuine ownership of a significant corporate relationship.
You will work directly with senior decision-makers, contribute to brand and marketing strategy and then lead the execution of that strategy through a substantial multidisciplinary team.
For an experienced marketing professional looking for 
greater ownership, visibility and international experience
, this represents an exciting opportunity to build your career in one of the Pacific region's most dynamic markets.





    	        
Apply

 Lae, Papua New Guinea
An exceptional opportunity exists for an experienced maritime executive to lead a large-scale commercial ship management operation in Papua New Guinea.
This executive position offers responsibility for the safe, reliable and commercially successful operation of a substantial marine fleet, while leading a significant organisational transformation across fleet operations, technical management, marine engineering, crewing, maintenance and compliance.
This is a role for a leader who enjoys being close to the operation, thrives in complex environments and can build high-performing teams while driving operational excellence.
The Opportunity
Reporting to the executive leadership team, you will have overall responsibility for one of Papua New Guinea's largest marine operations, including approximately 44 vessels and a workforce of around 600 employees.
You will provide strategic and operational leadership across:




Fleet Operations


Marine Engineering & Technical Services


Vessel Maintenance & Dry Docking


Crewing & Marine Personnel


HSSE & Marine Compliance


Procurement & Inventory


Commercial Performance


Operational Risk & Business Continuity




Working closely with senior stakeholders, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance safety, operational reliability, vessel availability and financial performance.

General Manager – Ship Management


Fleet Manager


Marine Operations Manager


Marine Superintendent


Technical Director


Head of Marine Operations

Extensive commercial shipping or marine operations experience


Fleet management and vessel performance


Technical management and marine engineering oversight


Dry docking and major maintenance programs


Marine compliance, ISM and Class requirements


HSSE leadership


Budget management and commercial accountability


Leading large multidisciplinary operational teams
