An exciting opportunity exists for an accomplished Chief Financial Officer to join the executive leadership team of a large and established logistics operation in Papua New Guinea.


This is a senior strategic leadership role with responsibility for the financial performance, governance and commercial stewardship of a diverse logistics business.


Working closely with the Executive Leadership Team, the CFO will play a critical role in driving sustainable profitability, capital discipline, operational performance and long-term business growth.


We are seeking a commercially astute finance executive who can operate beyond the traditional finance function – providing meaningful insight, challenging the business constructively and partnering with operational leaders to influence key commercial and investment decisions.


The Role Key responsibilities will include:




Providing strategic financial leadership across the logistics business


Leading all finance, accounting, reporting, budgeting, forecasting and control activities


Acting as a trusted financial and commercial advisor to the Executive Leadership Team


Driving financial performance, profitability, cost optimisation and operational efficiency


Providing commercial analysis to support pricing, growth initiatives and service expansion


Leading capital planning, investment evaluation and business case governance


Partnering with operational leaders on major fleet, infrastructure and asset investment decisions


Driving working capital optimisation, liquidity and cash flow discipline


Ensuring strong financial governance, internal controls, statutory compliance and risk management


Overseeing internal and external audit requirements


Evaluating strategic opportunities including acquisitions, joint ventures and partnerships


Developing meaningful financial dashboards, KPIs and management reporting to support decision-making


Leading and developing a high-performing finance team


Supporting finance transformation, ERP optimisation, automation and continuous improvement initiatives




To be successful in this position, you will ideally bring:




A degree in Accounting, Commerce, Finance or a related discipline


CPA, CA, CIMA or equivalent professional accounting qualification


A minimum of 12 years' experience in senior financial leadership positions


Demonstrated experience in financial management, commercial business partnering and investment governance


Experience operating within a large, complex and/or multi-site organisation


Strong capability across budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis and performance management


Proven experience in capital management, cost control and business performance improvement


Strong knowledge of financial governance, risk, audit and internal controls


Excellent commercial judgement and the ability to influence senior operational and executive stakeholders


Demonstrated leadership capability with experience developing high-performing finance teams




Experience within logistics, transport, industrial or other operationally complex sectors would be highly regarded, as would exposure to ERP implementation, systems improvement and digital finance transformation.
The Opportunity This position will suit an experienced finance executive who enjoys being close to the operational side of a business and wants to make a tangible impact on commercial and organisational performance.

28736.description:
Manager – Financial Accounting
Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea
An exciting opportunity exists for a technically strong accounting professional to join the finance team of a leading financial services organisation in Papua New Guinea.
This is a key management-level appointment suited to a qualified accountant who has developed strong technical foundations through audit, professional services, banking or a sophisticated corporate finance environment and is now looking to broaden their commercial and leadership experience.
Working closely with the Financial Controller and senior finance leadership, you will play an important role across financial control, month-end, management reporting, technical accounting and audit while gaining exposure to senior management and governance reporting.
For an ambitious finance professional, this position offers a genuine pathway towards broader senior finance leadership.
The Role Your responsibilities will include:




Preparing, reviewing and progressively leading month-end, quarterly, half-year and annual accounting processes.


Preparing and reviewing monthly management reporting and financial analysis.


Reviewing Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss movements and investigating unusual transactions.


Reviewing general ledger and Balance Sheet reconciliations and ensuring discrepancies are resolved.


Reviewing journals, accruals and month-end accounting entries.


Supporting the preparation of half-year and annual financial statements.


Providing oversight and support to the Accounts Payable function.


Managing and supporting internal and external audit requirements.


Researching and contributing to technical accounting papers and the accounting treatment of new or complex transactions.


Supporting regulatory reporting requirements.


Contributing to annual budgeting, planning, business cases and finance-related projects.


Supporting the preparation of senior management, Risk Committee and Board reporting.


Coaching and developing junior members of the finance team.




About You
We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate strong accounting fundamentals rather than simply experience following established processes.
You will ideally possess:




A tertiary qualification in Accounting, Commerce or a related discipline.


CA or CPA qualification.


Strong technical financial accounting capability.


Big Four or other leading audit experience highly regarded.


Experience interpreting and applying accounting standards.


Strong knowledge of general ledger accounting, reconciliations, journals and month-end processes.


Experience dealing with external auditors and technical accounting queries.


Banking or broader financial services experience would be highly regarded.


Commercial accounting experience following professional services would be advantageous.


Strong analytical and problem-solving capability.


Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


Leadership capability and the ability to coach and develop others.


The confidence to work with senior stakeholders and challenge accounting treatments where appropriate.




Candidates currently working within a major banking, financial services or sophisticated corporate finance environment are also encouraged to apply where they can demonstrate strong technical accounting capability.
Career Opportunity This position offers considerably more than traditional financial accounting.
You will work closely with experienced senior finance leaders and progressively take greater ownership of financial control and reporting activities. You will also gain exposure to senior management and governance forums, including opportunities to contribute to Board and Risk Committee reporting.
The organisation places a strong emphasis on professional development and building future leaders. For the right individual, this role provides an excellent platform to progress towards Financial Controller, Head of Finance or broader senior finance leadership opportunities.
The Opportunity
This role would particularly suit a CA/CPA-qualified accountant with a strong audit background who is looking to transition further into commercial finance, or an experienced financial services accountant seeking greater responsibility, leadership exposure and career progression.
An attractive remuneration package will be negotiated based on experience.





    	        
Apply

28632.description:
Job Type:
 
Permanent
 
About us 


K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate. 


We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.


About the role


In this role you will be the designated medic at our exploration camps, where you will be required to handle medical emergencies and manage multiple tasks at once at our remote exploration camp sites. You will render pre-hospital emergency care according to established medical protocols and perform a variety of emergency medical treatment services at the basic and advanced life support levels.


Key / Major Accountabilities


Key accountabilities of this position include.




              Consistently diagnose or perform actions in the absence of a physician


              Configure, pack and select only the appropriate medical equipment in a backpack then transport the equipment and perform medical duty on steep slopes in a hot and wet climate over great land distances


              Maintain physical condition to conduct long term bush walks for several kilometers in uneven and steep terrain in austere conditions


              Qualifications and strong experience in emergency /pre-hospital emergency medicine ideally with wilderness, search and rescue, and/or expedition support experience


              Up to date and continuous emergency training in skills such as ACLS and PHTLS, and proficiency with advanced airway skills.


              Attend site wide weekly and monthly safety meetings.


              Ensuring that the camp and mine site safety regulations are observed by all K92 employees including contractors, casuals, and visitors to site.


              Assess and report accident to the Management.


              Provide safety induction to new intakes, casuals, contractors, and visitors to site.


              Other duties as required from time to time.


              To ensure the safety rules and other policies of the camp and mine site are observed and report any suspicious activities.


              Attend to other safety administrative duties in line with role and as instructed by immediate Supervisor.


              Maintain safety work standards in accordance with government regulations and company policy.


              Perform all roles and responsibilities that support and reflect the company’s mission and core values.




About You 


To be considered for this role, it is essential that you must have a




              Advanced knowledge of EMS practices, medical terminology, EMS equipment and medical systems.


              A Degree or Diploma in Environmental Health from a recognized institution or equivalent.


              A Diploma or certificate in Health Extension or General Nursing is an advantage.


              Registered HEO, Nurse or CHW


              Current Basic Trauma Life Support certificate


              Current First Aid Advanced Certificate


              Emergency Medical Technician certificate (EMT) would be an advantage


              Must have 5-10 years exposure in Paramedics.


              Training and Assessment experience and qualifications


              2 – 5 years’ experience in occupational health and safety in mining environment would be an advantage.


              Well-versed experience in mining safety management.


              Excellent oral and written communication skills.


              Proficient in computer and e-mail correspondences.


              Ability to meet communicated schedules and deadlines.


              Strong planning, interpersonal and organizational skills


              Current PNG Driver’s license.


              Exposure to Emergency Response teams, processes.




Life at K92  


Our core values — Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, Excellence, and Safety — are central to our operations and fundamental to our success. K92 upholds a commitment to equal opportunity, striving to ensure that every individual can reach their highest potential without experiencing discrimination.


Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.


We believe in sharing our success with our employees. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer participation in long- and short-term incentive plans. We also offer savings programs, medical assistance, as well as access to our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster. 


If you share our values and are looking for your next career step, come join us on this exciting journey. Submit your application through our website today.


THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP 





    	        
Apply

GRADUATE DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM – PROJECT DELIVERY
 Are you a high-achieving graduate ready to turn theory into real-world impact? Our client, a major infrastructure organisation, is looking for driven graduates to join its project delivery team on an 18-month development program. You won’t be filing papers in a back office. You’ll work alongside experienced professionals on large transport and maritime infrastructure projects that will shape the country’s economic future.
 
Project Management Graduates 
 You’ll learn how major projects are delivered from the inside. You’ll help manage workplans, schedules and milestones, keep risk, issue and decision registers up to date, and track procurement and contracts. You’ll also help prepare project reports for senior stakeholders and funders, and join site visits and progress meetings. Along the way you’ll build practical skills in planning, risk management, procurement and contract administration that employers across the region value highly.
 
Engineering Graduates 
 You’ll get supervised, hands-on technical experience across several infrastructure projects. You’ll help review drawings and design submissions, join site inspections, and track quality testing and non-conformances. You’ll also help prepare site reports and support safety and environmental monitoring. Throughout, a qualified engineer will mentor you and you’ll build an evidence portfolio that supports your path to professional accreditation.
 
What’s in it for you
 You’ll have a personalised development plan, structured training and rotations, and regular capability assessments to track your growth. You’ll gain experience on real projects that most graduates wait years to get, and you’ll finish the program with a strong professional portfolio and a network of industry experts behind you.

28889.description:
Goodman Fielder Papua New Guinea is one of PNG’s largest food companies, manufacturing and distributing high-quality Flour, Stock Feed, Snacks and Bakery products throughout the country. The company owns a host of iconic brands which include; Flame Flour, Flame Stockfeed, Bilas Bread, Arthur's Pie, Twisties, Skel Rice and the Meadow Lea range.


At GFI, we care about making everyday food better for everyone.


Our goal is to be the leading and most innovative food company with a mission to meet our customers’ needs for superior quality foods with brands that are trusted by families everywhere.  We are the go-to source of consumer, shopper, and customer insights to help our customer and business partners succeed.


We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven 
Laboratory Technician
 to join our 
Quality Assurance
 team based in 
Lae
. This role performs accurate and timely chemical and physical testing of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products (flour, feed, rice, snacks, and edible oils), ensuring compliance with product specifications, food safety standards, and regulatory requirements. The role supports product release decisions, process control, and continuous quality improvement across site operations.


 


KEY DELIVERABLES


Product Development & Trials




Conduct baking trials and analysis to verify production quality


Assist in the development and reformulation of Rice, snacks, oil, flour, bakery and ingredient products (e.g. breads, flour-based products).


Plan, prepare and execute benchtop, pilot, and plant trials and accurately record trial data, observations, and results.


Support scale-up from lab to factory where required, ensuring process capability and product consistency.




Laboratory & Analytical Testing




Conduct physical, chemical, and sensory testing (e.g. moisture, texture, weight, volume).


Prepare samples for internal and external testing where required.


Maintain R&D laboratory equipment calibration and cleanliness.


Ensure test methods are followed consistently and results are reliable.




Quality & Food Safety




Ensure all development work complies with GF Quality Management Systems, HACCP, and food safety standards.


Support root cause investigations for product quality issues (e.g. customer complaints, defects).


Work closely with Quality to validate product specifications and shelf-life.




Documentation & Reporting




Maintain accurate records of formulations, trial data, and test results.


Update product specifications, process instructions, and development reports.


Support SAP or equivalent systems with product and trial data entry (if applicable).




Process & Continuous Improvement




Identify opportunities to improve product quality, cost, or efficiency.


Support ingredient optimisation and alternative raw material evaluations.


Participate in troubleshooting production issues related to product formulation or processing.




Cross-functional Collaboration




Work closely with Production, Quality, Procurement, and Supply Chain teams.


Support technology transfer and training of production teams following successful trials.


Contribute to site and group R&D initiatives.




 


KEY COMPETENCIES / EXPERIENCE


Technical/Functional Capabilities




Basic understanding of food science, particularly bakery/flour-based systems


Laboratory testing skills (physical and analytical methods)


Ability to follow structured test methods and SOPs


Competence with Excel and data recording tools




Experience / Qualifications Required




A tertiary qualification in science or food science preferred


1-3 years in a food manufacturing, laboratory, or R&D environment (preferred)


Experience in bakery, flour milling, rice, oil, snacks or FMCG production is advantageous




 


KEY PERFORMANCE MEASURES (BIG ROCKS)




Timely testing and assessment of the quality of finished products.


Timely delivery of development projects


Reduction in product defects and variability


Compliance with food safety and quality standards


Maintain cleanliness of R&D lab and equipment


Effective support of problem-solving and root cause investigations




 


KEY RELATIONSHIPS




Production teams, QC, Lab and QA personnel


Sales and marketing personnel




 


Be part of the Skel life and join a team that values healthy eating and active lifestyles and wants to share that with all the people of PNG. Email your EOI and CV/Resume/Supporting Docs in 1 PDF file and send to email: 
[email protected]
.


In the subject line address as 
“Laboratory Technician".


Applications close 
Wednesday 28th October 2026.


Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.


 


 


 





            

        
Apply

28887.description:
Goodman Fielder Papua New Guinea is one of PNG’s largest food companies, manufacturing and distributing high-quality Flour, Stock Feed, Snacks and Bakery products throughout the country. The company owns a host of iconic brands which include; Flame Flour, Flame Stockfeed, Bilas Bread, Arthur's Pie, Twisties, Skel Rice and the Meadow Lea range.


At GFI, we care about making everyday food better for everyone.


Our goal is to be the leading and most innovative food company with a mission to meet our customers’ needs for superior quality foods with brands that are trusted by families everywhere.  We are the go-to source of consumer, shopper, and customer insights to help our customer and business partners succeed.


We currently have an immediate vacancy for a 
QA/QC and R&D Supervisor
 to join our 
Quality Assurance
 team based in 
Lae
. Reporting to the 
QAQC Manager
, this role is responsible for leading all Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Laboratory and Feed Research & Development activities within the agricultural sectors of the business. The role ensures compliance with feed/food safety, regulatory, customer and Goodman Fielder requirements while driving continuous improvement in feed/food quality, raw material performance, manufacturing processes and product development. The position provides technical leadership across feed formulation, analytical testing, supplier quality management, complaint investigation and new product development to ensure the business consistently delivers safe, compliant and cost-effective feed.


 


KEY DELIVERABLES


Feed/Food Safety & Compliance




Establish and maintain a strong feed/food safety culture.


Ensure compliance with Goodman Fielder Quality Standards, HACCP requirements, PNG regulatory obligation and good manufacturing practices.


Maintain customer confidence through consistent product quality and feed safety performance.




Innovation & Product Development




Support development and commercialisation of new products.


Identify opportunities for formulation optimisation and performance improvement.


Lead technical support activities for poultry, livestock and aquaculture products where applicable.




Operational Excellence




Drive quality improvement initiatives that reduce product variability, waste and customer complaints.


Develop quality metrics and reporting systems that support business performance.


Lead continuous improvement projects across laboratory, manufacturing and raw material quality systems.




Capability Building




Develop technical competence within QA, QC and laboratory teams.


Deliver feed safety and quality training programs for operational personnel.




Technical Deliverables


Quality Management Systems




Maintain site HACCP plans, prerequisite programs and quality systems.


Manage internal audits, corrective actions and verification activities.


Ensure all specifications, SOPs and quality documentation remain current and effective.




Raw Material Quality Assurance




Establish and maintain raw material monitoring programs.


Assess supplier performance and technical compliance.


Investigate raw material non-conformances and implement corrective actions.


Support supplier approval and risk management processes.




 


KEY COMPETENCIES / EXPERIENCE


Technical/Functional Capabilities


Feed Manufacturing Knowledge




Strong understanding of feed milling operations including knowledge of ingredient receiving, grinding, batching, mixing, pelleting and dispatch processes.


Understanding of feed quality drivers and process controls.




Feed Safety & Quality Systems




HACCP implementation and verification.


Risk assessment and preventive controls.


Feed industry quality management systems.




Laboratory & Analytical Competence




Feed chemistry and analytical testing.


Proficiency in interpreting laboratory data.


Statistical analysis and trend management.




Raw Material & Supplier Management




Ingredient specifications and quality management.


Supplier approval and performance monitoring.


Knowledge of grain and protein ingredient quality variability.




R&D and Innovation




Product development and formulation optimisation.


Trial design and validation.




 


KEY PERFORMANCE MEASURES




Feed/Food safety incidents = Zero.


Customer complaints reduced year-on-year.


Raw material and finished product compliance >99%.


Successful completion of internal and external audits.


Reduction in feed quality variability.


New feed products delivered successfully.


Laboratory turnaround times achieved.


Quality cost reductions and continuous improvement targets met.


Team engagement and capability improved.




Laboratory Management




Manage microbiological, chemical and physical testing programs including competitor benchmarking.


Ensure laboratory equipment calibration, maintenance and verification activities are completed.


Ensure analytical data accuracy, integrity and traceability.




Feed Manufacturing Quality Control




Monitor production quality parameters including particle size distribution, pellet durability, moisture levels, density and physical quality, mixing uniformity, nutritional compliance.


Verify conformance to feed specifications before release.




Feed Safety Management

28868.description:
Ok Tedi Development Foundation (OTDF)
 is a not-for-profit organization, operating independently of Ok Tedi Mining Limited since 2010, and is a 100% owned Papua New Guinea company mandated to ensure the wise and sustainable use of the wealth created from mining operations for future generations and delivers projects to communities through a unique partnership between mining, the people and government of Papua New Guinea.


Applications are now open for a qualified and experienced professional to join the executive management team, based in Kiunga, Western Province.


EXECUTIVE MANAGER – PROGRAM SERVICES 


 


This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer and is a member of the Executive Management Team. The EM-PS provides leadership and provides leadership and direction to achieve agreed strategies, objectives and annual targets for the program services functions (including regional operations, procurement and logistics, monitoring and evaluation, and program planning and implementation in the 5 OTDF sectors of health, education, community and social development, local and regional economic development and infrastructure development.


Key Responsibilities


 




Establish and maintain strategic partnerships with key funding and donor organisations to sustain a pipeline of priority CMCA projects that meet individual selection criteria.


Liaise with key stakeholders including National and Provincial Government officials responsible for medium term and sectoral planning to ensure alignment of programs with government priorities.


Develop and maintain networks of experienced development organizations, and individual consultants with technical and project management expertise for possible contracting at different stages of the project cycle.


Establish and maintain ongoing implementation partnerships with key PNG and international organisations with relevant technical expertise and research capabilities (e.g. NARI, UPNG, UniTech, DFAT, B4D, Abt Associates, OLAM etc.)


Foster external networks and lead identification of funding opportunities for priority OTDF sector programs.


Promote and lead identification of program / projects with results frameworks and related indicators that align with OTDF and other relevant sectoral objectives.


Lead promotion and communication of OTDF achievements in implementing projects.


Ensure program milestones, inputs and financial reporting comply with agreed quality indicators, timeframes, and funding agreement; and M & E obligations are fulfilled.


Provide high level oversight of the monitoring and evaluation function, and related policies and procedures.


Ensure data for key indicators is collected and analysed and reported as required for approved program / project M & E frameworks.


Report to EMT, and the Board and in the Annual Report on contribution of specific projects to OTDF Headline Indicators.


Chair the Disciplinary, Events and Risk Committees as well as being a member of the EMT


Lead research, analysis, identification and implementation of business improvement initiatives in the range of program service functions (including regional operations; procurement and logistics; monitoring and evaluation; and program planning and implementation in the 5 OTDF sectors.


Advise the Chief Executive Officer of any emerging risks in the relevant areas of responsibility and recommend action.


Ensure health and safety policies are implemented to target zero harm work-related injuries and illnesses within OTDF and for contractors.


Foster a corporate culture that promotes ethical practices and encourages individual integrity; and maintain a positive and ethical work climate that is conducive to attracting, retaining, and motivating the highest quality employees.




 


Qualification & Experience


 




A Master’s degree in Sustainable Development, Community Development, Project Management, or another discipline relevant to OTDF’s development mandate.


Membership of, or affiliation with, relevant professional associations is desirable.


Demonstrated experience in a similar organisation, such as a foundation with a corporate social responsibility mandate, community development NGO, donor agency, or development funding organisation.


Experience working with or for international consulting firms is an advantage.


Demonstrated experience in tender preparation, procurement processes and tender evaluation.


Proven ability to strategically manage contracts with individuals, companies and service providers, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring and compliance.


At least 10–15 years of management experience in a reputable project management or development organisation, such as an NGO, donor agency or consulting firm, including a minimum of five years in a senior management role.


Demonstrated experience in managing development projects in at least two of OTDF’s five priority sectors, covering the full project cycle from identification and design through implementation, monitoring, evaluation and completion.


Proven experience in leading multidisciplinary teams and working effectively within a small, senior management team.


Demonstrated knowledge and experience in establishing and managing project monitoring, evaluation and reporting systems.


Substantial senior-level experience representing an organisation and engaging effectively with external stakeholders, including government agencies, corporate partners, development organisations and community representatives.


Proven ability to prepare and deliver high-quality written reports, briefs and presentations, and communicate effectively with diverse audiences, from community members to senior national leaders. Experience engaging with print and electronic media is an advantage.


Sound understanding of government planning, budgeting and public financial management systems, particularly within the Papua New Guinea context.


Willingness and ability to live and work in a remote location in Western Province.


Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Excel, with advanced Excel skills required.




 


Kiunga is a remote location in the North Fly District of Western Province of PNG. The candidate needs to be well suited to working in an isolated environment and must be self-motivated. He must be able to manage a FIFO roster of 8 weeks on/2 weeks off and have a well-balanced corporate profile with an understanding of the context within which OTDF operates, and an ability to interact with rural communities as required.


 


More specific details of these positions may be sourced from OTDF’s Human Resource Section via email to: 
[email protected]
.


 


OTDF offers both residential and FIFO (Fly in/Fly Out) status positions, along with a competitive remuneration and benefits package based on qualifications and work experience.  Any demonstrated experience and results-based Monitoring & Evaluation Experience is highly preferable.  If you would like to be a part of the OTDF team, please submit your application consisting of a covering letter, curriculum vitae and a statement addressing the selection criteria (please do not send copies of certificates and awards at this stage) along with the names and contact details of 3 professional referees to:


 


Manager - Human Resource


Ok Tedi Development Foundation


PO Box 21, 
KIUNGA 335


North Fly District


Western Province


 


Or email 
[email protected]
              


Applications close: 
27 October 2026


 


Note
: 


 


If you do not hear from us, 2 weeks after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. 
Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for inter
view
.


 


Authorized by


 


 


Andrew Mari


Chief Executive Officer

28893.description:
Job Type:
 
Permanent
 
About us 


K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate. 


We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.


About the role


As our site continues to grow with production doubling in 2026, we have created a new role that will lead the site services and utilities planning function.


In this role you will be responsible for the effective planning, scheduling, and coordination of maintenance activities to optimise equipment performance and reliability. Utilising Pronto as the core CMMS, you will be charged with forecasting component requirements, tracking critical equipment metrics, and ensuring efficient resource allocation. This role plays a key part in minimising equipment downtime through structured planning, monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.


Key Accountabilities


Key accountabilities of this position include.




Develop and implement maintenance schedules for both planned and corrective maintenance activities to ensure equipment reliability and operational efficiency.


Work with Maintenance and Power Station teams to ensure schedules are achievable and that they are achieved.


Train and direct the Data and Parts Clerks to ensure they work as required to support the Planning and Scheduling activity and to ensure they correctly prepare work order work packages for the supervisors.


Identify safety hazard on task and incorporate into plan.   


Responsible for initial screening of work orders and analyse of required level of planning, arrange for parts, skilled tradesman and TA and hours required to perform task,


Liaise directly with suppliers for quotation and raise Purchase order as instructed by Superintendent and Managers


Daily Report, Weekly Report and Monthly Reports updated as required


Communicate clearly with contractors’ resources on specific task assigned to contractors.


Ensure work orders are closed once task completed within 24 hrs and parts required for next service are sourced and planned in to forecast.


Ensure weekly schedules and daily service sheets on all equipment are provided


Daily Updating of Generator machine hours 




About You 




Mechanical/electrical trade and/or Bachelor of Engineering degree (Mechanical or Electrical)


Strong understanding of Construction, General Building Maintenance and Fixed Plant, mainly Generators.


5 years of practical experience in a maintenance-focused industry, preferably in a mining environment.


Proficiency in Pronto ERP or other CMMS platforms.


Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and Power BI for data analysis and reporting.


Strong knowledge of condition monitoring, failure analysis, and reliability metrics..


Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Project, Outlook).


Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.


Excellent trouble shooting skills.


Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.


Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.


Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.


Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.




Life at K92  


K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.


Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.


At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.


In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster. 


THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP





    	        
Apply

28860.description:
About Newmont


At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.


About Lihir


Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.


We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.


Purpose


As Engineer, Structural, you will provide civil and structural engineering design and modifications within the process plant and associated mine site infrastructure that shall meet company specifications, comply with operational requirements, agreements and relevant standards.


Essential Duties




Provide civil and structural engineering designs and calculations to relevant design codes and standards.


Review and investigate proposed structural modifications within the process plant and mine site infrastructure and provide engineering guidance.


Conduct site inspections and prepare conceptual structural design options for presentations to clients and stakeholders.


Prepare for review detailed drawings suitable for construction.


Liaise with inter-departmental clients, stakeholders and external consultants if necessary for design parameters and project requirements.


Identify and evaluate potential risks related to structural designs and construction methodologies, implementing robust mitigation strategies to enhance safety and project viability.


Provide technical support during the construction and installation phases, ensuring structures are built according to the design specifications.




Training & Experience




Bachelor’s Degree qualification in Civil Engineering, 3-5 years of structural engineering experience in a mining or heavy industry environment.


Registered with IEPNG


Demonstrated competence in the application of Australian Standards 


Strong technical capability in steel structures and structural concrete.


Strong attention to detail and documentation capability.


Experience in the use Space Gass Software.


Strong capability to perform relevant engineering calculations to support designs.


Able to read, understand and prepare engineering drawings.


Capability to review engineering drawings and red-line in consultation with the design team to ensure accurate design and construction drawings.


Excellent planning and organizational skills.


Excellent communication skills and ability to work with minimal supervision


Good computer literacy and understanding of Microsoft software suite


Understanding of safety compliance and regulations


Valid Class 6 Driving License




Working Conditions


This is a FIFO opportunity based at Newmont's Lihir operation in Papua New Guinea, working a 21 days on / 21 days off roster. The role combines office-based engineering design with field inspections, stakeholder engagement and construction support within a large-scale gold processing and mining environment.
At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.


We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply – we’d love to hear from you!





    	        
Apply

28850.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE


PNG Chiefs is seeking an experienced and versatile Travel Officer to plan, book and manage all domestic and international travel and accommodation for our players, coaching and support staff, executives and official delegations. Reporting to the CEO's Executive Officer, you will be the go-to person for flights, visas, passports, accommodation and team travel logistics, making sure every trip runs smoothly, safely, on time and within budget. This is a fast-paced, hands-on role suited to someone who thrives on organisation, attention to detail and keeping people moving.


Key Areas of Responsibilities




Plan, book and manage domestic and international flights for players, staff, executives and official guests


Coordinate group and charter bookings for away games, training camps, pre-season tours and official events


Prepare and lodge Australian visa applications and follow up with the Department of Home Affairs


Process PNG passport applications and renewals, and entry and work permit for non-citizen staff, through ICA


Maintain a register of passports and visas and flag renewals well before expiry


Book domestic and international accommodation, and manage room lists, check-ins and cancellations


Arrange airport transfers, team buses, vehicle hire and excess baggage or equipment freight


Prepare and distribute clear travel itineraries and travel packs before departure


Manage changes, cancellations, delays and rebooking quickly to minimize disruption


Build strong relationships with airlines, travel agencies, hotels and transport providers, and negotiate competitive rates


Track travel costs against budget, process supplier invoices and travel allowances, and reconcile accounts with Finance


Keep accurate, confidential travel records and act as first point of contact for travel issues, including after hours when required




What We’re Looking For




Diploma in Tourism and Hospitality, Business Management or a related field


Minimum 3–5 years’ experience in travel coordination, corporate travel, a travel agency or an airline


Extensive knowledge of airlines, routes, fares and travel agencies, with existing working relationships


Existing working relationships with ICA and Australian Immigration (Department of Home Affairs)


Sound knowledge of the visa and passport application process for Australia and PNG


Proven experience booking domestic and international travel and accommodation, including group bookings


Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and online booking platforms


Experience in sport, events or large-group travel, or with a GDS such as Amadeus or Sabre, is an advantage




Skills & Attributes




Highly organised, with excellent planning and time-management skills


Strong attention to detail and accuracy with bookings and documents


Versatile and adaptable, able to juggle multiple trips and shifting priorities


Calm, resourceful and solution-focused under pressure and at short notice


Sound judgement, integrity and professional behaviour at all times


Discreet and trustworthy with personal information and travel documents


Excellent communication and customer service skills in English and Tok Pisin


Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills


Team player who is reliable, proactive and takes ownership


Flexible and willing to work after hours and weekends when travel requires it




How to Apply


Send your CV and a short cover letter outlining your relevant experience to 
[email protected]
 by Monday, 26 October 2026.
 Please include “Travel Officer” in the subject line.


We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.





            

        
Apply

28836.description:
Job Type:
 
Permanent
 
About us 


K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate. 


We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.


About the role


This role is vital for real-time monitoring and management of plant operations, ensuring that production meets demand without compromising safety. Part of the responsibilities includes monitoring the SCADA system, identifying and responding to any abnormalities that could affect plant operations and maintaining daily log records to ensure that there is a clear historical account of operations.


Key Accountabilities




Manage plant despatch in line with Production Demand


System monitoring the ability to fault find, fully understand all alarms and respond decisively when required to maintain effective and efficient operation of the power station.


Conduct routine plant inspection


Monitor & Manage Plant SCADA system


Report immediately any system abnormalities


Maintain Daily Log Records


Control Start/Stops


Carry out shift hand over


Manage the PTW and LOTO System


Liaise with operational service planners regarding corrective and planned maintenance activities. Raise corrective work orders where required


Work closely with maintenance personnel to ensure all maintenance activities are planned and completed as scheduled.


Revise and follow standard operating procedures




About You 


Qualifications & Experience


To be considered for this role, you must have previous experience in power plant operations.  




Licensed Electrician with substantial experience


HV Switching Certificate (preferred)


Ability to demonstrate competent technical knowledge of general plant and system processes, electrical and SCADA systems


Ability to demonstrate competent technical knowledge in analysing equipment performance and identifying performance issues


Ability to quickly assess information to diagnose problems and opportunities


Ability to work collaboratively within a high performing, multi-disciplined, diverse team.




Life at K92  


K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.


Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.


At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.


In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster. 


THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP 





    	        
Apply

Location: Head Office – Port Moresby


Division: Daltron


Department: Application Support


 


Overview


We are seeking a skilled and motivated 
Printer / Copier Technician
 to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of multifunction printers, photocopiers, and related office equipment for corporate and commercial clients. Install, commission and configure Daltron-supported printers, copiers, scanners and multifunction devices in accordance with manufacturer, customer and company standards.

The Chinese Translator directly reports to the Project Manager – Infrastructure Projects and is responsible for providing accurate interpretation services between Chinese and English languages during meetings, conferences, construction activities, and other business interactions to support the Projects Department by being able to read, comprehend and translate Chinese words and ideas into English and Tok Pisin and vice versa while retaining the core ideas and information from the original texts. The Chinese Interpreter plays a crucial role in facilitating smooth cross-cultural communication between K92 Mining Projects Department and our sub-contractor.


Key / Major Accountabilities


Key accountabilities of this position include.




Provide accurate interpretation between Chinese and English languages during meetings, conferences, and other business-related events.


Assist in translating written documents, such as emails, reports, and presentations, from Chinese to English and vice versa.


Conduct research and gather information to ensure accurate understanding and interpretation of technical terms and industry-specific jargon.


Act as a cultural liaison, helping to bridge the communication gap between Chinese and English-speaking colleagues and clients.


Maintain confidentiality and professionalism while handling sensitive information and discussions.


Collaborate with other interpreters and translators to ensure consistent and accurate interpretation across different languages.


Stay updated with industry trends, news, and developments in both Chinese and English-speaking markets.


Provide language support during negotiations, and other business-related activities.


Continuously improve language skills and cultural knowledge through professional development opportunities and self-study.


Actively promote initiative-taking safety behaviours and leading by example




About You 


To be considered for this role, you must have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong character who is prepared to make hard decisions and deliver results. In addition to this, you will have the following.




Must have a university degree in a relevant area.


Intermediate-to-advanced Business English proficiency to translate in a business context from Chinese language to English language.


Demonstrated experience in the translation of business communications and technical documentation.


Must have a solid understanding of computers with experience in the application and use of MS Office


Excellent oral and written communication skills.


Give attention to detail.


Interpersonal skills using tact, patience and courtesy




Life at K92  


Our core values — Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, Excellence, and Safety — are central to our operations and fundamental to our success. K92 upholds a commitment to equal opportunity, striving to ensure that every individual can reach their highest potential without experiencing discrimination.


Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.


We believe in sharing our success with our employees. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer participation in long- and short-term incentive plans. We also offer savings programs, medical assistance, as well as access to our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster. 


If you share our values and are looking for your next career step, come join us on this exciting journey. Submit your application through our website today.
